modes.name: Always on
modes.summary: WiFi stays connected, the board just waits between readings.

modes.name: Modem sleep
modes.summary: WiFi stays connected, the radio naps between beacons.

modes.name: Light sleep
modes.summary: The CPU pauses and keeps its memory. WiFi reconnects for every reading.

modes.name: Auto light sleep
modes.summary: Power management sleeps on its own and keeps WiFi connected. Needs a core built with CONFIG_PM_ENABLE; the precompiled Arduino core 3.3.12 is not, so no board offers it.

modes.name: Deep sleep
modes.summary: Everything off except the clock. The board restarts for every reading.
modes.typicalCurrent: 10–150 µA chip, dev boards often 1–10 mA

modes.name: Hibernate
modes.summary: Like deep sleep, with the RTC memory off as well. Only the timer wakes it, no fast reconnect.
